limits: All measurements are bone origins/FK. Not actual skinned shoe soles, contact labels, penetration or visual naturalness.
No gameplay groundLift/entryExit blend applied. Current runtime uniform groundLift is external and cannot remove time-varying FK errors.
Original t0 reference frame is not a dance observation: supplied samples0 and1 are held same first valid source pose; final 30s endpoint not included in the900 original-index comparison.
No IK/root correction/foot locking/contactWindows inferred or written.
Uniform comparison is source position scaled by reported hip-height factor and translated to target rest hips. It is a proportional reference, not a target anatomical ground truth.
Source numeric unit is reported as exported units; source trajectory can be read in each target metre scale without assuming FBX units.
